"import cadquery as cq

# Sketch plane: YZ (local u -> global +Y, local v -> global +Z)
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Regular polygon vertices in LOCAL sketch coordinates (mm)
local_pts = [
    (22.213486, -3.737309),
    (5.314143, 8.997259),
    (-12.019334, -3.139773),
    (-5.83267, -23.375439),
    (15.324376, -23.744737),
]

# Map local (u, v) to world coordinates on the YZ plane
world_pts = [P.toWorldCoords((u, v)) for (u, v) in local_pts]

# Build exactly 5 line edges forming the closed polygon loop
edges = []
n = len(world_pts)
for i in range(n):
    j = (i + 1) % n
    edges.append(cq.Edge.makeLine(world_pts[i], world_pts[j]))

assert len(edges) == 5, "Expected exactly 5 curve entities"

# Export as a compound of edges
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
